```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  collapse = TRUE,
  comment = "#>"
)
library(bbstruct)

## Data Input

bb0 <- bb_read_csv(system.file(
  "extdata", "example_block.csv", package = "bbstruct"
))
bb_validate(bb0)

## Reordering

res <- bb_reorder(bb0)
met <- bb_metrics(res)
met$contrast
met$adjacent_col_smoothness

## Diagnostics

bb_metrics(res)

## Species Groups

bb_species_groups(res)

## Site Groups

bb_site_groups(res)

## Column Blocks

bb_column_blocks(res)
